text:
Hi everyone!
I wanted to ask if any one in this group has been able to source documents for their Indian partner? 

I'm an Indian passport holder but have not lived in India all my life (lived in Singapore and UK across my life) and my partner (Israeli citizen) and is now looking to initiate the process for me to come over. I believe I'm supposed to get documents which are apostilled from India alongside documents from other countries that I have lived in. I'd be grateful if any one in the group is able to share how they were able to source documents. 

Thank you as always!
